steps: Read the existing Paused UI, click Resume, press M and click Zoom out once to inspect the pickup to the south of the current area. Click Close map, then Space and W+A 0.7 s. Fresh state still shows City map, focused Close; the Space tap has reopened the map and the movement hold occurred while map was open.

Click Close again. Fresh AX and screenshot show grounded 0 km/h, pickup 1,948 m, boost 10.0 s and focus on Minimap. Click the visible game scene at (300,220), tap Space, then W+A 0.7 s. This produces actual visible flight, approximately 760 m direct distance, 9.3 s boost in AX (9.1 s in the following live screenshot) and 30 km/h in AX.

W+A 0.4 s and W 4.0 s continue flight movement; press P. By this pause the car is near building geometry at 0 km/h. Resume, press M and inspect location, then click Close. The off-road post-flight HUD is approximately 733 m with 0.0 s boost. Press R once and allow the visible glide to settle without movement input; the recovered road HUD is 1,879 m at 0 km/h.

W 1.5 s/S 0.6 s follows the narrow route to 1,865 m. W+A 0.22 s/W 1.6 s/S 0.65 s corrects lane position and reaches 1,841 m. W 1.2 s/S 0.6 s reaches 1,835 m at 0 km/h near a facade. W+D 0.2 s/W 1.0 s/S 0.45 s moves toward the T junction, reaching 1,818 m.

W+A 0.8 s/S 0.35 s begins the marked left turn (1,820 m). W+A 0.5 s/W 1.6 s/S 0.65 s completes most of the turn and reaches 1,806 m, with 2.5 s boost earned. W+A 0.15 s/W 2.5 s/S 0.8 s overshoots the following junction into a frontage; HUD changes to Return to a road for GPS and approximately 673 m direct distance. No unreachable-road or collision defect is inferred from this steering attempt.

Press R a second time and wait for settlement. An intermediate HUD reads 1,782 m; the settled street view reads 1,770 m, 0 km/h and 2.5 s boost on a broad clear street. Perform the controlled focus/Space check described below while keeping the same order.

After the controlled repeat, capture the final original HUD, press P and verify Paused/Resume focus. Read warning/error logs (empty), mark the tab as handoff, save two original screenshot byte arrays through the supported local 4198 HTML form, verify receipts, close both helper tabs and re-mark the old ECIL/LB/Kompally tabs without inputs. Release owned lock and notify root at 21:24:46 UTC.

findings.title: Space reopens the focused minimap after closing the map instead of starting flight
